description: A relay reporting that it is watching for NOTHING must survive the trip intact. Every count is present at zero and each lane's running flag rides beside it, because a zero is unreadable alone: no mDNS watch with the lane ON means the generation declared no mDNS patterns, and the same zero with the lane OFF means this deployment never bound multicast — different problems with different owners. A second report then REPLACES the first wholesale rather than merging, so a count from a retired generation cannot survive into the view of a current one; and a relay that has never reported stays ABSENT rather than being minted with zeroes, since zeroes are the alarm and minting them would raise it on every fresh feeder. A third report models the dev box's own state — one BUILTIN mDNS watch and no SSDP — because that is the case that tells the watching-nothing judgement apart from a per-lane one: a relay holding a watch in either lane is discovering, and an OR would raise the alarm on a fleet that is working.
